name: Tongnanlong
sum: Tongnanlong is a mamenchisaurid sauropod from the Late Jurassic Suining Formation of Chongqing, China, one of the largest of its family.
wsnote: Estimated at up to 25-26 m (Wikipedia revision).
holotype: TNM 0254, with three dorsal and six caudal vertebrae, the left scapula and coracoid and hindlimb elements including a partial tibia, fibula and three metatarsals.
biology: No biological statement was read in the sources consulted.
author: Wei et al. 2025

sources.text: Wei, X.; Tan, Y.; Jiang, S.; Ding, J.; Li, L.; Wang, X.; Liu, Y.; Wei, G.; Li, D.; Liu, Y.; Peng, G.; Zhang, S.; Lao, C. 2025. A new mamenchisaurid from the Upper Jurassic Suining Formation of the Sichuan Basin in China and its implication on sauropod gigantism. Scientific Reports 15. doi:10.1038/s41598-025-09796-0
